proposal_rule.finite_fallback: alpha0 for finite inherited violation; no repeated optimizer/backward or new packet.
proposal_rule.float32_endpoint: alpha1 uses original native endpoint, alpha0 exact old table; intermediate old+alpha*(native-old) in native dtype. It is endpoint filtering, not an Adam-rate or intended-displacement equivalence claim.
proposal_rule.native_proposal: one native Adam/A2/direct-response update followed by original hot-row correction
proposal_rule.nonfinite_behavior: Poison and stop, do not backtrack around NaN/Inf.
proposal_rule.selection: First finite candidate with training max slope <= training bound; strict comparison, no relaxed scientific or training tolerance.

proposal_sampling.actual_packet: Capture before/after native G noise-generator states, actual output tensor, frozen pre-call controller and sigma actually used.
proposal_sampling.baseline_guard: F0 must be bit-identical to actual G fake; every replay must reproduce original post-call generator state.
proposal_sampling.private_replay_draws: Count every private randn call and coordinate despite primitive reuse.
proposal_sampling.replay: Private generator reset to copied actual pre-call state, native controller.perturb_latent(record=False) at proposed table/support, IdentityG, same output_sigma times replayed next primitive normal draw. Recompute DV12 support radii; do not translate an old residual or use bare clean G.

state_and_order.boundary: Pinned private _settle_observe(index0) callback inside native after_generator_step, after hot correction before G displacement observation. Source-bound prototype, not a general public API extension.
state_and_order.complete_checkpoints: Caller envelope plus native state, exact task/adapter identity, observers/target cursor/actual packets, gradients, logical records. Ready phase only.
state_and_order.controllers: Native stationarity receives actual accepted table displacement; all other controller/noise/row/birth/EMA laws remain enabled. Endogenous responses are recorded, not forced to match control.
state_and_order.fault_injection: CPU software control only; must remain false in prospective science.
state_and_order.native_histories: Retain computed native gradients, Adam moments/clocks and learned-noise parameter update; apply fraction to table only.
state_and_order.partial_failure: Preserve physical optimizer entries and returns, actual component clocks/flags/models/optimizer state/packets/RNG and poison. Use fault_export components as NON_RESUMABLE. Do not equate completed returns with attempted calls.
state_and_order.recovery: No scientific retry in this registration. Any separately authorized recovery requires a fresh public constructor and exact retained complete pre-step caller envelope; do not bypass warm/cold validator or erase failed holder.
state_and_order.unsupported_post_boundary_motion: Stop with poisoned receipt if finish/birth changes table after accepted endpoint; do not disable native birth/hot mechanisms.

training_statistic.bound: max(reg_kappa, statistic of the consumed pre-G-optimizer training packet under same after-D critic)
training_statistic.meaning: If already above kappa, forbid additional worsening; do not assert universal kappa satisfaction.
training_statistic.population: actually consumed G training fake, with original DV12 perturbation and original output noise, same12 row identities
training_statistic.threshold_owner: unchanged Recipe.reg_kappa=1, not evaluator thresholds or scores
